note: Cua (cua.ai, formerly branded trycua / c/ua) is a YC Spring 2025 (S25) company based in San Francisco building an open-source computer-use agent framework and cloud VM fleets (Linux, Windows Server 2022, macOS) for AI agents; founder Francesco Bonacci previously worked at Xbox/Microsoft AI. The YC company page confirms the exact website domain cua.ai used by this provider (the 'cua-windows' card), so the YC hint is confirmed as the same company, not a different one. Could not confirm total funding raised, last round details/investors, or revenue in the ~15 minute budget because general web search (DuckDuckGo, Bing, Google, Startpage, Ecosia, Mojeek) all returned bot-blocking/CAPTCHA pages, and Crunchbase's page for the company was Cloudflare-blocked; no TechCrunch or similar press coverage of a funding round was located via direct site search either.
